name: band half kneeling chop
description: A band chop from a half kneeling position, building core stability and rotation.
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
